fields.label: Description
fields.value: Program booklet printed in black ink on glossy paper for the Berkeley Jazz Festival 1975, featuring Eddie Harris, Taj Mahal, Gil Scott-Heron, Canonball Adderley, Stanley Turrentine, Freddie Hubbard, Grover Washington, Jr, Joe Bataan, Les McCann, and Donald Byrd & the Blackbyrds. Although the event took place in the Bay Area, Los Angeles-based businesses played a support role: 2001-Promotions prooted the event; Paul Downs of View Park sold reproductions and posters on behalf of the artists; and Brockman Gallery Productions took out a full-page ad on the back cover.
